origin.description: Build a cpt object from a PELT search.
origin.example: cpts(class_input(x, "mean", "PELT", "Normal", "Manual", 10, 1, TRUE, PELT(cbind(c(0, cumsum(x)), c(0, cumsum(x^2)), cumsum(c(0, (x - mean(x))^2))), pen = 10, cost_func = "mean.norm")))

translation.description: Build a cpt object from a PELT search.
translation.details: Numeric series follow coredata of a plain vector. The index of that series is 1 to n.
